exercise.task: The supplied setup creates selected from active installations and draws their hours/output pairs. Annotate the highest-output active installation as Active peak, offset (8, 8) points with an arrow. Keep the prepared population and labels. Chart: title "Installation outputs"; x "hours"; y "output".
exercise.solution:
peak = selected.loc[selected["output"].idxmax()]
ax.annotate(
    "Active peak",
    xy=(peak["hours"], peak["output"]),
    xytext=(8, 8),
    textcoords="offset points",
    arrowprops={"arrowstyle": "->"},
)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd

data = {
    "name": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"],
    "active": [True, False, True, True, False],
    "hours": [2, 3, 5, 7, 9],
    "output": [10, 99, 24, 18, 60],
}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import seaborn as sns

selected = df[df["active"]]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.scatterplot(data=selected, x="hours", y="output", ax=ax)
ax.set(title="Installation outputs", xlabel="hours", ylabel="output")
